props.body: Economists usually measure GDP by adding up four kinds of spending in a year.
items: Investment: what businesses spend on equipment and buildings.

name: Text block
purpose: Explain in words what the components around it show.
description: A paragraph that explains, with optional numbered or bulleted steps and small print.

items.description: Steps or points under the paragraph, in order.

listStyle.description: Numbered when order matters, such as steps.

note.description: Small print, such as an assumption or a source.

guidance.summary: Explains in words what the components around it show, or what a person should know before acting.
useWhen: A finding needs a sentence of interpretation that no figure states: why it moved, what it means, what to do.
Steps a person follows in order.

avoidWhen.text: The text would restate figures or labels shown beside it; let the component speak.
Records with attributes belong in rows.
A difference between two values: show both values.
An exception that needs attention now.

states.label: Default
states.description: A paragraph, with optional steps or points and small print.

dos.title: Meaning, not the numbers again
dos.description: Say why a figure matters; the figure is already on screen.

dos.title: One idea per block
dos.description: A second idea is a second block, or it is not needed.

donts.title: Restating adjacent data
donts.description: People read the same facts twice and trust neither.

donts.title: Explaining the interface
donts.description: If a part needs a paragraph to be understood, change the part.

donts.title: A generic change summary
donts.description: “Several values were updated” hides the values; show them.

content: Lead with the conclusion, then the reason.
Write for the decision on the screen, not for completeness.

notes: Plain text in a paragraph; steps are an ordered list when order matters.
Small print stays readable: it is muted, not tiny.

composition.defaultVisible: The paragraph and its steps; small print below.
composition.density: In a dense screen, at most one short paragraph per section; longer explanation moves to a closed region.
composition.contentLength: One to three sentences on a task screen; up to 600 characters in a report.

redundantWith.reason: A banner and a paragraph saying the same thing compete.
Prose that lists attributes repeats the list.

mistakes: A paragraph that repeats the figures beside it.
An introduction that explains what the screen is for.
Long explanation open by default on a task screen.
composition.responsive: Lines stay under 72 characters; the block reflows.
